name: Ranger Elemental Conduit
body:
Elemental conduits foster a unique bond with nature’s elements, more so than with its terrain types.

An elemental conduit has the following class features.

Nature’s Blessings (Su)

At 3rd level, an elemental conduit gains a pool of conductivity points equal to 1 + 1/2 his elemental conduit level, which he can use to power his supernatural elemental abilities. He selects one of the following warpriest blessings: air, earth, fire, water.

This choice is permanent and cannot be changed.

Using a standard action, an elemental conduit can spend one point from his conductivity pool to activate the minor ability of his chosen blessing. At 8th level, and every five levels thereafter, an elemental conduit selects another of the warpriest blessings from above. At 13th level, an elemental conduit can use his conductivity points to power major blessings, but doing so requires the expenditure of two conductivity points. An elemental conduit is free to use the points in his conductivity pool to power an ability from among any of his chosen blessings.

This replaces favored terrain.
